purpose: Clarify distinct published cohort and HF SAE case definitions, not to certify source custodian signed pre-unblinding SAP or independent scientific review.

sources.preciseClaim: Primary NEJM report: randomized aficamten 258, placebo 259 (total 517), dual primary outcomes at week 36; LVEF below 50% occurred in 27 vs 2, and all-cause serious adverse events in 52 vs 38.

Earlier Cytokinetics topline release describes 516 randomized and treated participants (outside Japan). Analysis population and cutoff definitions not stated well enough to reconcile the 517 randomized paper population.

Published comparison explicitly lists ACACIA-HCM as 517 randomized (258 aficamten, 259 placebo), 516 treated. This provides a plausible cohort-definition explanation but is not a signed CONSORT data-set certification.

Sponsor-reported total heart-failure serious adverse events: 12 aficamten vs 3 placebo; 2 aficamten HF SAEs associated with LVEF below 50%, plus 10 aficamten HF SAEs not associated with LVEF below 50%; all aficamten HF events occurred before week 12 or during dose titration.

Circulation study authors state the multidomain responder analysis was included in the ACACIA-HCM SAP before database lock and unblinding. This is an author-reported chronology claim, not independently authenticated controlled SAP version/signatures or blind-break audit.

reportedCohorts.possibleInterpretation: 517 randomized versus 516 treated MAY be the explanation for the differing prior reports, but no original participant CONSORT line list or analysis-set allocation has been independently inspected.

earlierSourceCaseCount.provenance: Existing prior R36 research packet; exact original time window and definitions still require signed case listing.

reportedSafety.definitionInference: The October source divides the 12 aficamten HF SAEs into two LVEF strata; this alone does not explain why another source reported 11/1. Original case listings, data cutoffs, safety populations and event adjudication must be reconciled.
